entities.summary: Jan José De Brandt is a Belgian former volleyball player and current coach. He last coached for Fenerbahçe for 2017–18 season, before getting fired during playoffs. He also coached Fenerbahçe Acıbadem between mid of 2008–09 season to 2009–2010 season end, and led to win Women's Volleyball League and Volleyball Super Cup. He played volleyball between years 1967–1978 as a professional player and formerly coached CV Tenerife and Belgian national teams. He is married and has a son and a daughter who both also play volleyball. He speaks fluently Dutch, French, German and English.
